title: WatchObservation
description: watch.observation@1: one value a check recorded for a watch (plan T18): what was extracted, when, from which check run, and whether it changed or met the condition. value is the extracted value exactly as the source stated it, never inferred; snapshot is a capped copy of the raw body kept according to the watch's retention. Rows are immutable.

value.description: The extracted value as the source stated it: text, a decimal number, a structured object.

value_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical value.

previous_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous observation's value; null for the first observation.
